course.title: Unit 2 We're Family!【例句】
course.description: SECTION B What do you like about your family?

sentences.chinese: 你好，我是来自爱尔兰的Lily。

sentences.content: This is my dad, Fred, on the left.
sentences.english: This is my dad , Fred , on the left

sentences.content: He often plays tennis with me.
sentences.english: He often plays tennis with me
sentences.chinese: 他经常和我一起打网球。

sentences.content: My little brother, Sam, is on his knee.
sentences.english: My little brother , Sam , is on his knee

sentences.content: Sam is seven, and he really likes chess.
sentences.english: Sam is seven , and he really likes chess
sentences.chinese: Sam今年七岁，他非常喜欢国际象棋。

wordDetails.definition: like（第三人称单数）: 喜欢

sentences.content: My mum, Jane, is on the right.
sentences.english: My mum , Jane , is on the right

sentences.content: She always reads me a story at night.
sentences.english: She always reads me a story at night
sentences.chinese: 她总是在晚上给我读一个故事。

wordDetails.definition: read（第三人称单数现在时）: 读

sentences.content: My grandparents, Jack and Sarah, are in the middle.
sentences.english: My grandparents , Jack and Sarah , are in the middle

sentences.content: My grandparents have three grandchildren: Sam, my cousin Lucy, and me.
sentences.english: My grandparents have three grandchildren : Sam , my cousin Lucy , and me
sentences.chinese: 我的祖父母有三个孙辈：Sam、我的表妹Lucy，还有我。

sentences.content: They often say I'm their favourite grandchild.
sentences.english: They often say I'm their favourite grandchild
sentences.chinese: 他们常说我是他们最疼爱的孙辈。
